I believe that after understanding the basics of the language, students learn best by learning a language in context. In other words, after attaining a basic understanding of reading, writing, listening and speaking, it is best for students to continue their learning journey based on topics that interest them.

Students are then encouraged to emulate to the best of their ability.

CLASS OVERVIEW
We will work on a feature of native English pronunciation such as: sounds, word stress and rhythm, intonation, or connected speech

You will have a Google Doc with custom-made lessons tailored to your native language and you. I have designed study plans for speakers of major language families such as Russian, Chinese, Spanish, etc. You'll also have an app that easily does video, audio, and screen reording to monitor your progress.

25 or 50 mins
▸ Warm up & review (10 mins)
▸ Pronunciation exercises (20 mins)
▸ Long-form accent practice (20 mins)
▸ Summary & closing (5 mins)

▸ be ready for some complex material

This depends on you and your goals. I can tell you that students usually learn to correctly produce the sound or feature within one class, but then take a few weeks of self practice for it to feel natural

I have helped numerous people from all different types of languages and I have created specific lesson plans tailored to your native languages. Feel free to message me and I can send you the Accent Reduction course syllabus for your linguistic background
